nodes.name: Frame Sense
nodes.blurb: One more row on the weapon frame. Nothing else hands you one.

nodes.name: The Second Frame
nodes.blurb: And one on the chest. Your people cut brackets before they cut anything else.

nodes.name: Flush Fit
nodes.blurb: Every finished item pays a tenth more. Nothing is wasted at the joins.

nodes.name: Tighter Still
nodes.blurb: Another tenth. There is a point past which it stops being packing and starts being pride.

nodes.name: Thick Skull
nodes.blurb: Songil is survivable. Barely, and not twice in a week.

nodes.name: Corked
nodes.blurb: A strip of it, wedged where a blow lands. It comes back every fight.

nodes.name: Cave Lungs
nodes.blurb: Nine hundred feet of Deep Chocolate mine, and you never once came up early.

nodes.name: The Long Shift
nodes.blurb: Fourteen hours is a shift. Sixteen is a shift somebody is counting.

nodes.name: Handspan
nodes.blurb: You can still judge a gear by putting a hand across it. It is not a skill anybody taught you.

nodes.name: Anvil-Armed
nodes.blurb: The pit had one anvil and four hundred of you. You got your turn at it.

nodes.name: Funnel Drill
nodes.blurb: Army-issue, and it has somebody else's name filed off the side of it.

nodes.name: Jinx Read
nodes.blurb: You can tell which of the four it is before it lands. Knowing does not stop it.

nodes.name: The Fifth Frame
nodes.blurb: A row on the greaves. You walked out of the pit; you may as well arrive.

nodes.name: The Hat Band
nodes.blurb: A row on the helmet. The band is what a hat is; the rest of it is weather.

nodes.name: The Glover's Word
nodes.blurb: A row on the gloves. She measures both hands and cuts for the larger one.

nodes.name: Room For The Second
nodes.blurb: Another row on the weapon frame. Two blades is a different argument from one.

nodes.name: Let The Seams Out
nodes.blurb: One more row on the chest. Somebody let them out and did not write down who.

nodes.name: The Fourth Course
nodes.blurb: A row on the helmet, the gloves and the greaves. The weapon and the chest were let out years ago and nobody went back for the other three.

nodes.name: The Fifth Course
nodes.blurb: A row on the helmet, the chest, the gloves, the greaves and the weapon. A course is a course; you do not lay one down on half a wall and call it a morning.

nodes.name: Head Height
nodes.blurb: Another row on the helmet, the chest, the gloves, the greaves and the weapon. This is the height at which a man stops kneeling to work and starts telling you about his back.

nodes.name: The Last Course
nodes.blurb: One more row on the helmet, the chest, the gloves, the greaves and the weapon. Past this the frames do not take another. Eight is what the old shop built and nobody has improved on it since.

nodes.name: Nothing Left To Let Out
nodes.blurb: There is no more room in any frame to give you. What is left is what the room was worth: everything already on it, packed tighter, and the shoulders to carry the result.

nodes.name: Deadlift
nodes.blurb: A gorilla in a bedazzled plaid suit does not warm up. Neither do you.

nodes.name: The Figure Eight
nodes.blurb: Nobody scored it. Everybody saw it.

nodes.name: The Five
nodes.blurb: One judge gave it a five. The others gave it a two and a minus seven.

nodes.name: Bedazzled Plaid
nodes.blurb: Four thousand sequins, and a plate under them nobody has asked about.

nodes.name: Wider Frames
nodes.blurb: A row on the weapon frame. Your arms had to go somewhere.

nodes.name: Wider Still
nodes.blurb: And the chest, which is where the rest of you is.

nodes.name: The Full Lift
nodes.blurb: Four hundred and eleven pounds, held for nine seconds, on skates.

nodes.name: The Crowd
nodes.blurb: They are not cheering for the lift. They have never been cheering for the lift.

nodes.name: Army Issue
nodes.blurb: The funnel has somebody else's name filed off it. Everyone's does.

nodes.name: The Drillbook
nodes.blurb: Low-level goofs often go horribly wrong. Yours will not, because you read it.

nodes.name: A Wider Mouth
nodes.blurb: A row on the helmet. The funnel has to sit on something.

nodes.name: The Banana Standard
nodes.blurb: Regulation peel, regulation placement, regulation nine feet of skid.

nodes.name: Anvil, Own Foot
nodes.blurb: Self-deprecation is a supply line. The Jester dropped a moon with it.

nodes.name: Pie, Own Face
nodes.blurb: Held in reserve. Deployed once, at the correct moment, by a sergeant.

nodes.name: Concentrating Funnel
nodes.blurb: A row on the gloves. You cannot aim a funnel one-handed.

nodes.name: A Funny Undone
nodes.blurb: There is a version of every goof that does not land. You have met it.

nodes.name: The Worm Fact
nodes.blurb: THE WORM FACT REMAINS LAW. It is not a threat. It is a filing.

nodes.name: The Flesh Throne
nodes.blurb: Somebody sat in it before LETO. Nobody has asked who.

nodes.name: The Ledger
nodes.blurb: Every name, every date, and a column nobody will explain.

nodes.name: A Longer Body
nodes.blurb: A row on the chest. There is more of you than there was.

nodes.name: Worm's Patience
nodes.blurb: Death is not in a hurry. Death has never once been in a hurry.

nodes.name: Something Rotting
nodes.blurb: On the other side of it, and getting closer to your side of it.

nodes.name: The Slow Approach
nodes.blurb: A row on the greaves. Death arrives on foot.

nodes.name: Remains Law
nodes.blurb: Francis condensed Death's plane to a point once. The filing survived.

nodes.name: Filed Under The Roast
nodes.blurb: Two hundred and nine helmets are in the Keeper’s book, filed by what was still coming off them when they were handed back. Yours goes down as two hundred and ten, under the Roast.

nodes.name: The Standing Count
nodes.blurb: The Keeper counts what is out there twice a day and has never once gone out to look. The second count is the one filed. The first is kept for the difference, which is the part worth knowing.

nodes.name: The Licence
nodes.blurb: Nine pages, and eight of them are the list of what the licence does not cover. Page one is a drawing of a hand holding a thing, and under it, in Kaklon’s own writing, the words BOLT IT ON.

nodes.name: Kaklon Tolerances
nodes.blurb: Three hundred and twelve of the four hundred came back. The note that came back with them is the same note every time, and it is a compliment.

nodes.name: The Second Bench
nodes.blurb: The first bench is where the work is done. The second is where the gloves go while somebody decides whether it was done. Four hundred went onto the second bench and nothing has ever come off it.

nodes.name: Bench Rights
nodes.blurb: Signed on the back of a form for something else. Two hundred and six of these were issued in one afternoon and the afternoon has not been explained. Yours is the two hundred and seventh, and it comes with the turn already in the envelope.

nodes.name: Overwind
nodes.blurb: The instruction is to wind it until it stops and then give it one more. Nobody at the bench has ever needed the instruction twice.

nodes.name: The Flywheel
nodes.blurb: Kaklon's own drawing has the wheel at four inches and a note beside it reading FIVE. Every flywheel on every bench is five inches and nobody has changed the drawing.

nodes.name: The Counterweight
nodes.blurb: Eleven pounds of something the invoice calls BALLAST and the customs form calls the same thing in a different hand. It is on the outside of the work and it is what stops the work coming off.

nodes.name: Patent Pending
nodes.blurb: Filed in the ninth year and pending ever since. The office that would grant it was reflected into the Archive in the fourth year and has been answering letters from in there, at a rate of two a decade.

nodes.name: Top Billing
nodes.blurb: Eleven seasons of it, and the poster is the same poster with a new date pasted over the old one. They have run out of room and started pasting over the eleven.

nodes.name: The Follow-Through
nodes.blurb: The bat leaves your hands at the top of it and nobody in the ground looks at where it lands. They are all still looking at you.

nodes.name: In the Ninth
nodes.blurb: Chonga hit one thing in the ninth and it was the ninth for eleven years afterwards. Nobody says which season.

nodes.name: A Warm House
nodes.blurb: Six thousand of them and every one already standing. The two who sat down are discussed afterwards and at length.

nodes.name: First Bell
nodes.blurb: He is out of the tunnel before the bell finishes. The stewards have written to him about it four times.

nodes.name: House Lights
nodes.blurb: One lamp over the whole ground and it is pointed at one man. The other nine lamps were taken down in a season nobody will name.

nodes.name: The Incident
nodes.blurb: It is on the record as an incident because the word they wanted was not available to the clerk writing it down.

nodes.name: Eleven Seasons
nodes.blurb: They gave him a rack with eleven hooks on it and he has used one. The weapon frame that came with it has a row on it nobody has filled either.

nodes.name: The Firebox
nodes.blurb: Forty kettles and one firebox under all of them. Somebody has to keep it fed and it is not going to be the fire.

nodes.name: The Damper
nodes.blurb: You can shut one side of it down. Whether you should is a different question and it is asked four times a minute.

nodes.name: Coal by the Hundredweight
nodes.blurb: Eleven of them a shift, and the ninth is the one that decides what sort of day it was.

nodes.name: A Hotter Draught
nodes.blurb: Open the door at the bottom and it pulls. It pulls whatever is in front of it, which is usually somebody's hat.

nodes.name: The Clinker Rake
nodes.blurb: What comes out the bottom is not coal any more and it is not ash yet. There is a tool for it and this is it.

nodes.name: Held Over
nodes.blurb: The shift ends and the fire does not. Somebody worked out that a banked pool is still warm after you have burned it.

nodes.name: Twice-Fired
nodes.blurb: Through the box once and through it again. Nine seconds faster and about four times as loud.

nodes.name: The Kettleworks Shift
nodes.blurb: Three hoppers, all full, and eleven hours between you and the end of it.

nodes.name: Banked Fire
nodes.blurb: You do not put it out. You rake it over and leave it, and in the morning it is still there, which is the whole trick.

nodes.name: A Word in the Ear
nodes.blurb: It is not a threat and it is not advice. It is a fact about the listener that the listener had not got round to.

nodes.name: Insight, Held
nodes.blurb: You have been listening for eleven minutes and have said nothing, which everybody in the room has now noticed.

nodes.name: The Second Word
nodes.blurb: The first one did the work. This one stops them putting it down.

nodes.name: Dread, Early
nodes.blurb: Before the bell, which is a thing you are not supposed to be able to do and nobody has written down that you cannot.

nodes.name: Two-Fifths
nodes.blurb: Three of them went down at a third and the fourth went down at forty percent, and the fourth is the one worth reading about.

nodes.name: What They Heard
nodes.blurb: A thick skull is nine inches of it and a word is not a thing you have to get through nine inches of.

nodes.name: The Long Whisper
nodes.blurb: Forty-five percent, and by then it has stopped being about the fight.

nodes.name: Three of Them
nodes.blurb: Marbulon's door has three behind it and nobody has ever said what one is. A row on the helmet, which is where the listening is done.

nodes.name: The Last Word
nodes.blurb: Half of what it was, through a third of what it had. There is no ninth thing to say.

nodes.name: The Rate Card
nodes.blurb: Pinned inside the funnel where the light is worst. Two figures, one crossed out, and the crossing-out is the older of the two.

nodes.name: Standing Order
nodes.blurb: Thirty points a fight, drawn whether you need them. Twenty-two fights in, nobody has needed all thirty and nobody has cancelled it.

nodes.name: The Overdraft
nodes.blurb: You may go twenty past empty. You may not go to nothing; the last point of you is not for sale and the clerk has that in writing.

nodes.name: The Rebate
nodes.blurb: A kill inside the fight refunds half the bill, paid at the bell, in strength, in front of whoever is left.

nodes.name: Shouted Figures
nodes.blurb: He shouts the exchange rate over the noise and the rate improves each time he shouts it. Four shouts is where it stops improving.

nodes.name: Both Books Open
nodes.blurb: One for one. The Sergeant stops arguing at one for one, which took eleven years and a funnel.

nodes.name: The Count
nodes.blurb: Three items. The fourth is what makes a fact an opinion, and nobody has explained why.

nodes.name: The First Fact
nodes.blurb: One fact, held open, for as long as you are carrying little enough to hold it.

nodes.name: Writ in the Margin
nodes.blurb: A fact that cannot expire is read more often, and reading it costs the reader.

nodes.name: The Second Fact
nodes.blurb: Two at once. The Keeper kept nine at once for a season and was asked to stop by six people who had all been counted.

nodes.name: Bare-Armed
nodes.blurb: Four items and the fact still stands. Past four it sits down.

nodes.name: Told Again
nodes.blurb: A fact that outlives the fight is told to the next thing you meet, once, before it has said anything.

nodes.name: Dry Bearing
nodes.blurb: An empty frame has nothing in it to slow down. Kaklon called this obvious in 1911 and nobody has built on it since.

nodes.name: The Empty Bench
nodes.blurb: Six more turns of nothing, banked. The bench does not know it is empty.

nodes.name: The Clearing
nodes.blurb: Every second turn, the bare cell next to worked ground becomes worked ground. Four turns is four cells and the frame is not empty any more, only unpacked.

nodes.name: Counterspin
nodes.blurb: Two stacks survive an activation. The arm does not stop; it is asked to pause and it declines twice.

nodes.name: Both Arms
nodes.blurb: A whole stack a turn off a frame with nothing in it. Twelve turns is twelve, which is more than most people manage with gear on.

nodes.name: Overwound
nodes.blurb: Sixteen over the old ceiling and it turns faster than that. The recall notice for this one is printed under the tap.

nodes.name: The Poster
nodes.blurb: Sixty percent, printed. The printer got it wrong and the house honoured the print, and has honoured it every night since.

nodes.name: Quick Change
nodes.blurb: Two seconds an empty frame. Five empty frames is ten seconds, which is the whole of the original window and the reason the window was ten.

nodes.name: The House Clock
nodes.blurb: Two seconds slow since 1904. Every act in the building is paid off it and no act has complained.

nodes.name: The Second House
nodes.blurb: Each paid win adds a second to the next window, up to five. A win outside the window puts it back to nothing.

nodes.name: No Encore
nodes.blurb: Fifteen points more for the act that does not come back out. The house has counted eleven encores in nine seasons and paid for none of them.

nodes.name: The Short Programme Itself
nodes.blurb: Twice the bill on a fast win with nothing on. The judges gave it a five, a two and a minus seven, and the box office does not read scores.

nodes.name: The Form
nodes.blurb: Five a fight. There is a box for a sixth and the box has never been filled in by anyone the Keeper will name.

nodes.name: Ripest First
nodes.blurb: Spend the one with the least time left rather than the cheapest. The clerk fought this for two years on the grounds that it was sensible.

nodes.name: Countersigned
nodes.blurb: Every third requisition puts the curse back where it was found, signed twice, still running.

nodes.name: Two Signatures
nodes.blurb: A spent curse covers half again what a cast costs, and the half again is banked rather than lost.

nodes.name: Standing Requisition
nodes.blurb: Eight a fight. The Sergeant signs the whole book at the start and hands it over open.

nodes.name: The Whole Book
nodes.blurb: Every second one comes back, and each covers double. The requisition is now cheaper than the cast, which the Sergeant says is how requisitions are meant to work.

nodes.name: The Tap
nodes.blurb: Eight a stack a turn. The tap is on the side of the funnel and the side of the funnel is the patent's, so the eight is licensed.

nodes.name: The Second Licence
nodes.blurb: It turns every eight hundred milliseconds instead of every thousand. Two hundred milliseconds, bought and paid for, twelve times a fight.

nodes.name: Full Rows
nodes.blurb: A row with no gap in it pays four a cell at the bell, and stays exactly where it is. Nothing clears; the row is the machine and clearing it would be taking the machine apart.

nodes.name: The Flywheel Brake
nodes.blurb: Two stacks survive the activation. A brake that keeps the wheel turning is what the patent office queried and what the patent says.

nodes.name: The Overflow Pipe
nodes.blurb: Funny past the top of the funnel comes out as Cork, one for one, down a pipe added in 1912 by somebody who was tired of mopping.

nodes.name: The Funnel, Patented
nodes.blurb: Twelve a stack a turn and the rows pay half again. Spike Kaklon has offered nine hundred Fnorp for the drawings on four occasions.

nodes.name: Longer Overture
nodes.blurb: Thirteen seconds. Three of them are the conductor deciding whether to start.

nodes.name: The Standing Discount
nodes.blurb: Twenty percent off after the window closes, on the grounds that the house is already warm.

nodes.name: Encore
nodes.blurb: A kill inside the window starts the window again. Once. The house has a rule about twice and the rule is the number two.

nodes.name: Unspent
nodes.blurb: Funny left over when the lights come up lands as Cork. Nobody at the house can explain the mechanism and the Cork is on you regardless.

nodes.name: Second Overture
nodes.blurb: Seventeen seconds. The programme lists it as four minutes and the programme is not the clock.

nodes.name: The Whole First Act
nodes.blurb: Two encores and half price after. Eleven seasons of first acts and the second act has been performed nine times.

nodes.name: The Searing Clause
nodes.blurb: Clause four. The weapon frame, every time it goes off, and the ench does not have to be told which weapon.

nodes.name: The Frost Clause
nodes.blurb: Clause seven, added when a licensee held both hands out and asked what the gloves were for.

nodes.name: Second Reading
nodes.blurb: Every third activation of an enched item lands its curse twice, and the item runs fifteen percent slower for the privilege. The office reads everything twice and takes longer.

nodes.name: The Stun Rider
nodes.blurb: A rider on the helmet, in a hand nobody at the office recognises, initialled by three people who have all left.

nodes.name: The Misfire Schedule
nodes.blurb: Schedule two, the greaves. Every third act of theirs does nothing, which the schedule describes as an administrative outcome.

nodes.name: The Licence Entire
nodes.blurb: Twice a curse on every enched activation, every clause, every frame. It is nine pages and eight of them are the list.

nodes.name: The Ledger Column
nodes.blurb: Fifteen percent a curse, in a column the Keeper added and the box office has never queried.

nodes.name: The House Count
nodes.blurb: Six counted instead of four. The two extra were being landed anyway and now they are being paid for.

nodes.name: Four Kinds
nodes.blurb: Four different kinds on one fallen creature pays double. Three kinds pays what three kinds pays, which is the point of the number four.

nodes.name: The Long Run
nodes.blurb: A curse that ran out before the bell counts for half. It was on them for most of it and the ledger says so.

nodes.name: The Billing Review
nodes.blurb: Twenty percent a curse. Reviewed in the eighth season, upheld in the ninth, reviewed again out of habit.

nodes.name: Eleven Seasons of It
nodes.blurb: Thirty percent a curse and nine of them counted. The act has not changed since the second season and the money has changed eleven times.

nodes.name: The Second Rack
nodes.blurb: Three a component. The rack was built for two and has four slots, which is the sort of thing the workshop did.

nodes.name: The Standing Order
nodes.blurb: The Index, off the house list, no charge. It has been on the list since the list was one item long.

nodes.name: Ponkey Broadcast
nodes.blurb: An enched component lends forty percent of what it is carrying to every finished item touching it. The lending is not noticed by the lender.

nodes.name: The House List
nodes.blurb: The Allowance, which the house has never charged for and has twice tried to stop giving away.

nodes.name: Wider Broadcast
nodes.blurb: Sixty-five percent, and it reaches diagonally now, which the workshop insists is the same thing.

nodes.name: The Bill in Full
nodes.blurb: Four a component and eighty percent lent out. Two licences, one rack, and a bill that runs to a second page.

nodes.name: The Open Grate
nodes.blurb: Nothing in it and a draught straight through. Four bare frames and the fourth is the loudest.

nodes.name: Draught Through the Frame
nodes.blurb: It pulls harder for having nothing to pull past.

nodes.name: Nothing to Slow It
nodes.blurb: Eleven of them stacked and none of them in the way.

nodes.name: The Cold Side
nodes.blurb: What you burned is still warm on the side nobody stands at.

nodes.name: Stripped for Firing
nodes.blurb: Everything off it, down to the brackets, which is nine fewer things to catch.

nodes.name: Furnace, Bare
nodes.blurb: There is no fourth thing to take off it.

nodes.name: The Exchange Window
nodes.blurb: Open eleven to four and shut the rest of the time, which is the Sergeant's idea of an exchange.

nodes.name: Standing Order, Hot
nodes.blurb: Filed nine times, honoured six, and nobody has asked about the other three.

nodes.name: The Boiler Receipt
nodes.blurb: Keep it. You will be asked for it and you will not have it.

nodes.name: Twice Through the Funnel
nodes.blurb: Down it, round, and down it again, at four times the rate and none of the sense.

nodes.name: The Rate Goes Up
nodes.blurb: It went up on the eleventh and nobody was told on the tenth.

nodes.name: Funnel, Fired
nodes.blurb: Both of them going at once, which the paperwork says is one machine.

nodes.name: Their Coal
nodes.blurb: It was theirs. It is in your firebox. Nobody has raised it.

nodes.name: Slow Match
nodes.blurb: Nine inches of it and it takes four minutes, which is exactly as long as you need.

nodes.name: A Fact in the Fire
nodes.blurb: A thing that is true for ever burns for ever, which is the Keeper's whole filing system.

nodes.name: Searing Hands
nodes.blurb: The gloves land it and the firebox takes it.

nodes.name: Their Coal, Twice
nodes.blurb: The second hundredweight off the same eleven people.

nodes.name: Stoke, Cold
nodes.blurb: It has not gone out in nine years and it has never once been lit.

nodes.name: The Governor
nodes.blurb: Two brass balls on a spindle, and when it goes too fast they go out and it does not.

nodes.name: The Licence, Warm
nodes.blurb: Signed on the boiler plate, which the office says counts.

nodes.name: Steam Kept
nodes.blurb: Eleven pounds of it in the drum and none of it going anywhere.

nodes.name: The Second Plate
nodes.blurb: Room on the component for one more, because the boiler plate has four holes and used two.

nodes.name: The Governor, Set
nodes.blurb: Wound to nine hundred and left there.

nodes.name: Boiler, Ponkey
nodes.blurb: The Turn, geared down eleven to one, into a firebox. Nobody asked it to.

nodes.name: The Flash Pan
nodes.blurb: Four ounces of it under a tray, and the tray is the part that goes.

nodes.name: A Longer Fuse
nodes.blurb: Nine seconds instead of four, which is nine seconds of everybody watching.

nodes.name: The Poster, Singed
nodes.blurb: It was a good poster. It is a better one now.

nodes.name: Damp Powder
nodes.blurb: It went up late and it went up anyway, which the hall preferred.

nodes.name: The Whole Pan
nodes.blurb: All of it. There was no reason to keep any back and there never is.

nodes.name: Powder, Flashed
nodes.blurb: Eleven seasons and this is the one they talk about.

nodes.name: The Plain Fact
nodes.blurb: No preamble and no second sentence. Four hundred pounds of nothing to say.

nodes.name: The Count
nodes.blurb: Two things on, and one of them is a ring.

nodes.name: Two-Fifths, Bare
nodes.blurb: Forty percent of what it was, and it was not wearing anything either.

nodes.name: What It Heard
nodes.blurb: A thick skull is nine inches and a plain fact is not slowed by inches.

nodes.name: Said Louder
nodes.blurb: The same four words, from closer.

nodes.name: Doubt, Loud
nodes.blurb: It sat down. Nobody has ever got it to say why.

nodes.name: The Unpaid Word
nodes.blurb: Form 9, unstamped, said out loud in a corridor.

nodes.name: The Form, Silent
nodes.blurb: Four boxes, all of them blank, all of them countersigned.

nodes.name: Heard Anyway
nodes.blurb: The requisition was denied on the eleventh and the thing happened on the ninth.

nodes.name: The Standing Silence
nodes.blurb: Filed once, honoured indefinitely, which is a thing the Sergeant discovered by accident.

nodes.name: The Unpaid Word, Twice
nodes.blurb: Two of them in one corridor, and the second is the one that lands.

nodes.name: Silence, Requisitioned
nodes.blurb: Nine copies. One of them is going somewhere.

nodes.name: Told Again
nodes.blurb: The second telling is the one that sticks, which is not how anybody wants it to work.

nodes.name: Four Kinds
nodes.blurb: There are exactly four and it is carrying all of them.

nodes.name: A Standing Fact, Heard
nodes.blurb: A thing that will not stop being true is a thing it cannot stop hearing.

nodes.name: A Word That Stops It
nodes.blurb: The helmet says it and the thing stops to think about it.

nodes.name: Told Louder
nodes.blurb: Eleven facts and it has run out of places to put them.

nodes.name: Once, Told
nodes.blurb: It only needed the one. The other nine were for you.

nodes.name: The Rumour Clause
nodes.blurb: Page eleven, subsection four, which permits saying things about people.

nodes.name: The Licence, Whispered
nodes.blurb: Off the house list, no charge, and nobody has been told why.

nodes.name: Two a Component
nodes.blurb: The rack was built for two and the licence finally agrees.

nodes.name: Broadcast, Quietly
nodes.blurb: An enched component lends what it is carrying, and the lender does not notice.

nodes.name: The Rumour, Twice
nodes.blurb: Said in two places at once, which the licence also permits.

nodes.name: Rumour, Licensed
nodes.blurb: Stamped, filed, and going round the Kettleworks in nine minutes.

nodes.name: The Last Line
nodes.blurb: Six words. Hanglo Chiemstar used them eleven seasons running.

nodes.name: A Longer Bow
nodes.blurb: Four of them, and the hall is still up on the fourth.

nodes.name: The Second House
nodes.blurb: They came back at nine to see it again.

nodes.name: The House Clock
nodes.blurb: It runs nine seconds slow and everybody has agreed not to fix it.

nodes.name: The Last Line, Held
nodes.blurb: Held for four beats, which is three longer than it reads.

nodes.name: Line, Curtain
nodes.blurb: And then the curtain, which is the part nobody remembers writing.

nodes.name: Ash in the Ear
nodes.blurb: Warm, and it has something to say.

nodes.name: The Draught
nodes.blurb: Both ends open and nine feet of it between them.

nodes.name: Two-Fifths, Burned
nodes.blurb: Forty percent of what it was, and most of that went up the chimney.

nodes.name: Held Over, Cold
nodes.blurb: What the furnace took is still paying half of what it paid.

nodes.name: Ash, Louder
nodes.blurb: Eleven hundredweight of it, and all of it saying the same thing.

nodes.name: Whisper and Ash
nodes.blurb: Nobody can tell which of the two did it and neither can you.
